# Just Enough Python {#sec-just-enough-python .appendix}

::: {.callout-note}
## Skeleton

Every construct the book uses, taught in about ten pages: variables,
strings and f-strings, functions, lists, dictionaries, loops, imports,
`pip install`, running a script. Written for the reader who has never
programmed; each construct links back to the first chapter that uses
it.
:::
